schema.description: An immutable money capture routed through a settlement channel.

amount.description: Amount as a JSON string on the wire.

amount_refunded.description:
Amount already refunded, as a JSON string (compensating records only;
`amount` itself is append-only and never changes).

application_fee_amount.description: Platform fee taken on the charge, as a JSON string.

balance_transaction_id.description: Ledger balance-transaction reference proving the money movement.

channel_id.description: Settlement channel that executed the charge (routing outcome).

on_behalf_of.description: Connected account the charge is on behalf of (split-at-charge).

schema.title: Charge

402.description: Screening blocked / channel declined — nothing written
